rows.grounds: compound of vṛthā (in vain) and āśramaḥ (effort, exertion)
refers to the practitioner in question
compound locative indicating the domain of practice

items.question: What consequence follows when exertion in mantra worship is futile?
premises: Exertion in mantra worship may be futile.
Such futile exertion belongs to that practitioner.
Accomplishment does not arise without effective exertion.
items.inference: Therefore futile exertion in mantra worship yields no accomplishment for that practitioner.
items.plain_english: His effort would be in vain, and he would have no accomplishment in mantra worship.
